subject.title: [Feature]: Expose sessionKey/runId to outbound message hook for deterministic verification

question: Should OpenClaw expose deterministic verification evidence on `message_sending`, make `reply_payload_sending` the supported pre-send verification API, or defer this to a broader outbound policy/trace-context design?
rationale: The missing piece is a plugin SDK/security contract rather than a narrow implementation detail; exposing transcript/tool evidence before delivery needs maintainer boundaries for privacy, size, and compatibility.

options.title: Design additive hook evidence contract
options.body: Keep this issue open and specify bounded run/session/evidence fields for the pre-send hook surface before implementation.

options.title: Route to reply_payload_sending
options.body: Declare `reply_payload_sending` plus existing run context as the supported API and close or narrow this issue to docs/follow-up gaps.

options.title: Fold into broader policy work
options.body: Make a related outbound policy or trace-context issue canonical and close this issue as superseded after preserving its verification examples.

recommendation.title: Design additive hook evidence contract
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open and specify bounded run/session/evidence fields for the pre-send hook surface before implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: They merged the closest prior hook work and already reviewed this issue's remaining contract gap.
